nodes.label: Feste Regeln (Fixed Safety Rules)
nodes.rationale: Outlook stays read-only (except creating calendar events) to prevent accidental sends/deletes to third parties; Google Drive gets full read/write since files are self-owned; no autonomous spending/contracts/messages without confirmation to avoid unauthorized commitments; the itzfabu/Javis backup repo is exempted from confirmation for git add/commit/push because it is a personal, non-production backup, reducing friction for routine automated backups while still requiring approval for force-pushes or any other remote.

nodes.label: Security Design (token auth, localhost bind)
nodes.rationale: Web chat requires an X-Jarvis-Token header and rejects foreign Origins so other sites/tabs cannot silently trigger actions; Flask binds only to 127.0.0.1 so it is unreachable from the network; guard-connectors.ps1 enforces the Outlook read-only rule at the tool level regardless of what is asked; generated/sensitive files are gitignored to avoid leaking tokens/session data.

nodes.label: Common Gotchas (lessons learned)
nodes.rationale: Git does not track empty folders, so PARA vault folders got .gitkeep placeholders after a clone-and-check restore test showed they were silently missing; concurrent pushes to main are a known unresolved risk now that cloud routines, the git-backup hook, and manual commits all target the same branch; PowerShell Get-Content -Raw round-trips can corrupt umlauts, so Claude's own Edit tool is preferred; JSON paths need forward slashes for settings.json; app.py now refuses to start if port 8420 is already bound, to prevent silent dual-instance conflicts.
